title: lineage-manifest v1
description: The record of one agent-lineage admission decision against the P11 contract. Admission is a contract, not a name: every field is evidence, and a non-admission is recorded with its reason, never waived silently.

name.description: The box lineage name (claudebox, kimibox, ...). One box instance runs one lineage, chosen at provisioning.

tool.description: The vendor tool the layer carries (claude-code, kimi-code, ...).

level.description: The strongest provenance level the vendor admits (P1). L1: Fedora dnf repos. L2: vendor RPM/dnf repo with gpgcheck=1. L3: last-resort official-upstream binary, graded.

grade.description: L3 only — c1 GPG signature, c2 published checksum, c3 resolve-log. Required when level is L3; absent otherwise.

pin.description: The exact pinned version or digest admitted.

source.description: Where the artifact comes from — the vendor repo or upstream release URL.

verification.description: How identity is verified at fetch time — gpg key id, checksum mechanism, repo-metadata signature.

last-live-check.description: Last date the source was fact-checked against the live upstream (P2).

headless.description: How headless non-interactive autonomous operation is achieved, with evidence.

self-update-disabled.description: The construction that disables the tool's own self-update, so a self-installed binary can never shadow the managed one.

state-outside.description: The persistent volumes holding everything durable — credentials, transcripts, configuration — outside the disposable layer.

policy-interface.description: How the loop's policy and permissions are enforced on this lineage.

reason.description: Required when status is non-admitted: which contract clause failed.
